title: Reel Obsession Sport Fishing
specs: Fish caught include salmon and trout
Boat is a 1995 Hydra-Sport walk-around 27’-1” with safety and navigation electronics
Valid Wisconsin Fishing License and Great Lakes Salmon & Trout Stamp required
Recommended to take Meclizine for motion sickness the night before and morning of trip
Boat capacity maximum seven people (five clients, first mate and captain)
includes: All fishing rods and reels are Shimano (Talora rods and Tekota reels)
Boat equipped with four Cannon MAG10 electric downriggers with Positive Ion Control
Boat equipped with two Taco Grand Slam 20’-0” outriggers
Safety gear required by USCG for operation on Lake Michigan
blurb: Guests join guided sport fishing trips on Lake Michigan targeting salmon and trout. The boat is a 27-foot Hydra-Sport equipped with fishing gear and safety equipment. Trips focus on fun, education about the lake's biomass, and catching fish.
extraNote: Captain decides to delay or cancel trip for safety due to inclement weather including thunderstorms, lightning, high winds, or Small Craft Advisories · If trip is canceled by Captain, customer can reschedule at a later date · Seven-day notification of cancellation by customer is appreciated to allow rebooking · 1750 N Lincoln Memorial Dr, Milwaukee, WI 53202
